target_pdb.description: Filesystem path to the target structure (.pdb) the binder is hallucinated against. Either supply this directly or pass upstream `candidates` carrying a structure_path.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when `target_pdb` is omitted.

target_chain.description: Target chain id(s) on the target PDB to design against. BindCraft accepts a comma-separated list to design against multi-chain epitopes.

target_hotspots.description: Hotspot residue positions on the target where the binder should engage. Interpreted as FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is supplied; otherwise treated as legacy PDB structure residue numbers.

target_hotspot_residue_ids.description: Explicit hotspot residue identifiers using the PDB residue naming convention `<chain><resnum>[icode]`. Use this when residue numbering does not start at 1 or when insertion codes are present.

target_sequence.description: Reference protein FASTA/sequence for the target. When provided, integer `target_hotspots` are interpreted as 1-indexed positions in this sequence and mapped onto PDB residue IDs.

target_fasta_path.description: Path to a FASTA file containing the target sequence. Alternative to inline `target_sequence` for position-mapping integer hotspots.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer position inputs (`target_hotspots`). `auto` picks sequence when a target sequence is provided, else structure; `sequence` forces 1-indexed FASTA positions; `structure` forces legacy PDB residue numbering.

binder_length.description: Fixed binder length in residues (BindCraft accepts a [min,max] range upstream; we pin both bounds equal here for determinism). Typical mini-binder range 50-80.

num_designs.description: Number of final accepted designs to produce (`number_of_final_designs` in BindCraft settings). BindCraft loops trajectories until this many designs pass the filter cascade.

num_recycles.description: AF2 recycles during the design trajectory (`num_recycles_design` in BindCraft's advanced settings). More recycles improve quality at higher cost.

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed for reproducibility. Null lets BindCraft choose its own seed.

max_trajectories.description: Optional upper bound on attempted BindCraft trajectories. Null leaves upstream behavior unbounded until `num_designs` designs are accepted; useful for capping smoke/CI runs.

filter_mode.description: Filter cascade strictness. `default` preserves upstream BindCraft thresholds; `permissive` disables thresholds for bounded smoke validation.
